exec header $TEST_SERVER_URL/example
stdout 'Title: Example Page'
stdout 'OpenGraph Type: website'
stdout 'Twitter Card: summary'
stdout 'JSON-LD Type: WebPage'

exec header -test $TEST_SERVER_URL/missing
stdout '--- Diagnostics ---'
stdout 'Missing fields:'
stdout '  - Twitter Card Data'

exec header -show-image $TEST_SERVER_URL/example
stdout 'Displaying image'
